# Config & Helper

```{r}
# ====== CONFIG ======
esm_dir      <- "ESM_Tiff/ESM_Tiff"                # folder with all crop .tif
prop_csv     <- "cadastral_master_26925.csv"       # 70 rows
initial_crs  <- 28355                              # set to your WKT CRS if different
majority_thr <- 0.5                                # majority-rule threshold
drop_variants <- TRUE                              # ignore *_1.tif variants

# ---------- Helpers (same logic as your prototype) ----------
# Read ESRI VAT DBF, find value & label cols like your code did
build_vat_lookup <- function(vat_path) {
  if (!file.exists(vat_path)) {
    return(tibble::tibble(code = integer(), label = character()))
  }
  vat  <- foreign::read.dbf(vat_path, as.is = TRUE)
  vcol <- grep("^value$", names(vat), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)
  if (length(vcol) != 1L) stop("No VAT 'Value' column in: ", vat_path)

  lcol <- grep("(suitab|class|label|cat|legend|desc|category)",
               names(vat), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)
  if (!length(lcol)) lcol <- vcol

  tibble::tibble(
    code  = vat[[vcol]],
    label = trimws(as.character(vat[[lcol]]))
  )
}

attach_levels <- function(r, vat_lu) {
  if (nrow(vat_lu) > 0) {
    r <- as.factor(r)
    # IMPORTANT: no terra:: prefix on a replacement function
    levels(r) <- data.frame(ID = vat_lu$code, class = vat_lu$label)
  }
  r
}

# Preload all crops once: read .tif, read VAT, attach levels, keep in memory
preload_all_crops <- function(esm_dir, drop_variants = TRUE) {
  crop_tifs <- list.files(esm_dir, pattern = "\\.tif$", full.names = TRUE)
  if (drop_variants) {
    crop_tifs <- crop_tifs[!grepl("_1\\.tif$", basename(crop_tifs), ignore.case = TRUE)]
  }
  rl <- purrr::map(crop_tifs, function(tif) {
    r <- terra::rast(tif)
    vat_lu <- build_vat_lookup(paste0(tif, ".vat.dbf"))
    r <- attach_levels(r, vat_lu)
    list(
      name   = tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(tif)),
      r      = r,
      vat_lu = vat_lu
    )
  })
  names(rl) <- vapply(rl, `[[`, character(1), "name")
  rl
}

```


# Summariser

```{r}
# ---- Summariser ----

summarise_one_property_one_crop <- function(prop_row, tif_path) {
  r <- terra::rast(tif_path)
  vat_path <- paste0(tif_path, ".vat.dbf")
  vat_lu <- build_vat_lookup(vat_path)
  r <- attach_levels(r, vat_lu)

  parcel_sf  <- sf::st_sf(
    PID          = prop_row$PID,
    POT_PID      = prop_row$POT_PID,
    MUNICIPALITY = prop_row$MUNICIPALITY,
    FULL_ADDRESS = prop_row$full_address,
    geometry     = sf::st_as_sfc(prop_row$parcel_wkt, crs = initial_crs)
  )
  addr_sf <- sf::st_sf(geometry = sf::st_as_sfc(prop_row$address_wkt, crs = initial_crs))

  if (!all(sf::st_is_valid(parcel_sf))) parcel_sf <- sf::st_make_valid(parcel_sf)

  parcel_r <- sf::st_transform(parcel_sf, sf::st_crs(r))
  r_crop <- terra::crop(r, terra::vect(parcel_r))

  r_rl <- raster::raster(r_crop)
  cell_df <- exactextractr::exact_extract(r_rl, parcel_r, fun = NULL, progress = FALSE)[[1]]
  if (is.null(cell_df) || nrow(cell_df) == 0) return(NULL)

  val_name <- setdiff(names(cell_df), c("coverage_fraction", "cell_area"))
  if (length(val_name) != 1L) stop("Unexpected raster columns from exact_extract().")
  cell_df <- dplyr::rename(cell_df, value = !!val_name)

  vat_lu_dedup <- dplyr::distinct(vat_lu, code, label)

  out <- cell_df |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(value), coverage_fraction >= majority_thr) |>
    dplyr::count(value, name = "COUNT") |>
    dplyr::left_join(vat_lu_dedup, by = c("value" = "code")) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      CLASS_LABEL = dplyr::coalesce(label, as.character(value)),
      CROP        = tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(tif_path))
    ) |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      PID          = prop_row$PID,
      POT_PID      = prop_row$POT_PID,
      MUNICIPALITY = prop_row$MUNICIPALITY,
      FULL_ADDRESS = prop_row$full_address,
      COUNT,
      CLASS_LABEL,
      CROP,
      GEOMETRY     = prop_row$parcel_wkt,
      ADDRESS_WKT  = prop_row$address_wkt
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(COUNT))

  out
}

summarise_one_property_one_crop_preloaded <- function(prop_row, r_pre, vat_lu, crop_name) {
  parcel_sf <- sf::st_sf(
    PID          = prop_row$PID,
    POT_PID      = prop_row$POT_PID,
    MUNICIPALITY = prop_row$MUNICIPALITY,
    FULL_ADDRESS = prop_row$full_address,
    geometry     = sf::st_as_sfc(prop_row$parcel_wkt, crs = initial_crs)
  )
  if (!all(sf::st_is_valid(parcel_sf))) parcel_sf <- sf::st_make_valid(parcel_sf)

  parcel_r <- sf::st_transform(parcel_sf, sf::st_crs(r_pre))
  r_crop   <- terra::crop(r_pre, terra::vect(parcel_r))

  r_rl   <- raster::raster(r_crop)
  cell_df <- exactextractr::exact_extract(r_rl, parcel_r, fun = NULL, progress = FALSE)[[1]]
  if (is.null(cell_df) || nrow(cell_df) == 0) return(NULL)

  val_name <- setdiff(names(cell_df), c("coverage_fraction", "cell_area"))
  if (length(val_name) != 1L) stop("Unexpected raster columns from exact_extract().")
  cell_df <- dplyr::rename(cell_df, value = !!val_name)

  vat_lu_dedup <- dplyr::distinct(vat_lu, code, label)

  out <- cell_df |>
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(value), coverage_fraction >= majority_thr) |>
    dplyr::count(value, name = "COUNT") |>
    dplyr::left_join(vat_lu_dedup, by = c("value" = "code")) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      CLASS_LABEL = dplyr::coalesce(label, as.character(value)),
      CROP        = crop_name
    ) |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      PID          = prop_row$PID,
      POT_PID      = prop_row$POT_PID,
      MUNICIPALITY = prop_row$MUNICIPALITY,
      FULL_ADDRESS = prop_row$full_address,
      COUNT,
      CLASS_LABEL,
      CROP,
      GEOMETRY     = prop_row$parcel_wkt,
      ADDRESS_WKT  = prop_row$address_wkt
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(COUNT))

  out
}

```


# load props

```{r}
# ---- 2) load_props(): NO lat/long processing; keep address_wkt only ----
load_props <- function(path, crs = 28355) {
  library(readr); library(dplyr); library(janitor); library(tibble)
  df <- suppressMessages(readr::read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE))
  if (ncol(df) > 1 && all(c("PID","POT_PID","full_address","parcel_wkt","address_wkt") %in% names(df))) {
    df <- df %>%
      janitor::clean_names() %>%
      rename(
        PID          = any_of(c("pid","PID")),
        POT_PID      = any_of(c("pot_pid","POT_PID")),
        MUNICIPALITY = any_of(c("municipality","MUNICIPALITY","council","lga")),
        full_address = any_of(c("full_address","address","FULL_ADDRESS")),
        parcel_wkt   = any_of(c("parcel_wkt","geometry_wkt","wkt","PARCEL_WKT")),
        address_wkt  = any_of(c("address_wkt","addr_wkt","ADDRESS_WKT"))
        # NOTE: no latitude/longitude renaming here
      )
  } else {
    raw_lines <- readr::read_lines(path)
    raw_lines <- raw_lines[nzchar(trimws(raw_lines))]
    cols    <- c("row_index","PID","POT_PID","MUNICIPALITY",
                 "full_address","parcel_wkt","address_wkt","latitude","longitude")
    rec_len <- length(cols)
    if (length(raw_lines) %% rec_len != 0)
      stop("File does not contain a whole number of 9-line records. Check formatting.")
    mat <- matrix(raw_lines, ncol = rec_len, byrow = TRUE)
    df  <- as_tibble(mat, .name_repair = "minimal")
    names(df) <- cols
    df <- df %>%
      select(-row_index) %>%
      mutate(
        PID          = as.character(PID),
        POT_PID      = as.character(POT_PID),
        MUNICIPALITY = as.character(MUNICIPALITY),
        full_address = as.character(full_address),
        parcel_wkt   = as.character(parcel_wkt),
        address_wkt  = as.character(address_wkt)
        # NOTE: we intentionally ignore latitude/longitude even if present
      )
  }
  # Required schema: NO latitude/longitude required anymore
  required <- c("PID","POT_PID","MUNICIPALITY","full_address","parcel_wkt","address_wkt")
  missing <- setdiff(required, names(df))
  if (length(missing)) stop("Missing required columns: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
  df
}
```


```{r}
# ---------- DRIVER (preloaded rasters) ----------
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(foreign)
library(exactextractr) 
library(stringr)
library(janitor)

# Read and deduplicate by PID (keep one per parcel)
props_raw <- load_props(prop_csv, crs = initial_crs)

props <- props_raw %>%
  mutate(PID = as.character(PID)) %>%
  arrange(PID) %>%
  distinct(PID, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Preload all crops ONCE
raster_list <- preload_all_crops(esm_dir, drop_variants = drop_variants)

# Compute: each property × each preloaded crop (no more per-iteration disk reads)
results_master <- purrr::map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(props)), function(i) {
  prop_i <- props[i, ]
  purrr::map_dfr(raster_list, function(rr) {
    tryCatch(
      summarise_one_property_one_crop_preloaded(
        prop_row  = prop_i,
        r_pre     = rr$r,
        vat_lu    = rr$vat_lu,
        crop_name = rr$name
      ),
      error = function(e) {
        message("PID=", prop_i$PID, " | CROP=", rr$name, " -> ", e$message)
        NULL
      }
    )
  })
})

# Split into per-PID tables (list of 20 tibbles)
tables_by_pid <- split(results_master, results_master$PID)

# Optionally write CSVs
# dir.create("property_tables", showWarnings = FALSE)
# purrr::iwalk(tables_by_pid, ~ readr::write_csv(.x, file.path("property_tables", paste0(.y, ".csv"))))
# readr::write_csv(results_master, "parcel_crop_suitability_counts_master.csv")

print(results_master, n = min(30, nrow(results_master)))
```
